messages:
kayla: kicking off deploy window for release v2.3.4 now — low-risk cutover but want quick eyeballs on SLOs and release notes before traffic shift. pinging @eng-oncall and @platform. link: https://internal/release/v2.3.4
leo: on it, opening SLO dashboard -> https://grafana.company/slo/release-v2.3.4 :eyes:
maria: skimming release notes, looks like embed caching tweak + kvcache GC change. nothing user-facing besides perf improvements. added note about rollback plan.
anita: noticed an increase in 5xx for embed-route in last canary during staging earlier. small sample but keep an eye on embed-p95 and 5xx-rate.
leo: moving to the dashboard now, will watch p50/p95/p99 and 5xx spike chart. setting short alert for immediate >0.5% 5xx delta.
deploy-bot: [info] starting staged rollout: v2.3.4 -> cohort A (5%) at 1799991120
sam: quick question — are we pinning model variant or using fallback routing?
kayla: pin variant redwood/embed-v3-quant to reduce cross-variant diffs for this roll. fallback remains available to small-routes.
maria: noted. also added a temporary rollforward threshold: if p95 increases >150ms sustained >3min -> pause and notify.
leo: cohort A steady so far. p95 +20ms, 5xx flat. no obvious errors in logs.
anita: logs show a handful of retries to storage during burst at 1799991148 — correlating with a background GC job. possibly noisy.
leo: can you paste the log snippet?
anita: ```
WARN embed-service kvcache: failed fetch key=abc123 attempts=3 latency=230ms
WARN storage-client: read timeout 3001ms
```
sam: thanks. sounds like transient storage flakiness, not model. recommend proceed but keep short guardrails.
kayla: agree. proceed to cohort B (25%) after 2m stable.
deploy-bot: [info] advancing rollout: cohort B (25%) at 1799991176
leo: beginning to see p95 creep to +60ms in eu-west-1, but 5xx still low. tracing shows longer storage reads queued.
maria: increasing KVCache prefix retention might help but that's a config tweak, not for this roll. we should keep monitoring.
anita: setting an alert: embed-route 5xx rate >0.8% for 5m -> escalate to #eng-oncall and pause-rollout.
kayla: noted. if 5xx >0.8% persist, we pause and roll back to v2.3.3.
sam: release-note update: added troubleshooting steps for storage timeouts and who to page.
leo: cohort B steady at 6m. p95 plateauing but within sLO guard. no 5xx alerts.
deploy-bot: [info] advancing rollout: cohort C (100%) at 1799991240
maria: after full shift, watch the traffic-weighted error budget. I'll keep a 10min radar on top charts.
anita: still seeing intermittent storage timeouts but not increasing. flagging ops to check slow disk metrics.
leo: looks stable for now, p95 within target and 5xx under threshold. recommend continue and close monitor.
kayla: rollforward approved. I'll update release notes with final deploy time and rollback plan archived. thanks everyone :tada:
deploy-bot: [success] rollout complete: v2.3.4 in production at 1799991287
leo: will do a follow-up thread if disk ops finds something.
maria: saved a snapshot of SLO charts at completion. link: https://grafana.company/snapshots/abc-v2.3.4
kayla: closing this huddle. great coordination.
